hypothesis.statement: On a real 32-channel forearm surface-EMG gesture (GRABMyo), the Hilbert amplitude envelope computed by emgEnvelope(method='hilbert') reproduces the canonical scipy.signal.hilbert (the analytic-signal magnitude) to machine precision on every channel, and the envelope shows clear burst activity (peak/mean modulation > 1) -- the gesture's muscle activation.

analysis_plan.dataset: GRABMyo forearm surface EMG (Pradhan et al. 2022, PhysioNet), session1 participant1 gesture10 trial1; 32 channels x 10240 samples at 2048 Hz

decision.threshold: descriptive: the Hilbert envelope equals scipy.signal.hilbert to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across all channels, and the envelope shows burst activity (mean peak/mean modulation > 1)
